parse_urdf_file: use URDFParser to parse a URDF XML file and extract links and joints
build_urdf_tree: construct a URDFTree from parsed links and joints to build a hierarchical robot structure
create_scene_graph: create a SceneGraph from a URDFTree root and joint angles to represent the robot scene
get_mesh_from_scene: call getMesh on a SceneGraph to retrieve Open3D mesh geometries for visualization
visualize_robot_mesh: use open3d draw_geometries to render the mesh geometries from a SceneGraph
